messages:
leo: Quick sync  For the 'error-ref' page I noticed an inconsistency in wording between 'timeouts' and 'server timeouts (504)'. I opened a micro PR to standardize phrasing and to add a tiny troubleshooting example for truncated responses: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4912

mira: Thanks. Can you put the truncated-response curl example here? I'll use it for the QA checklist.

leo: Sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"long-8k","input":"<very long prompt>"}' -i
```
If you see partial responses with status 200 but missing expected end token, check gateway logs for upstream timeouts and client-side streaming termination.

sam: Also add a note about buffering in proxies and nginx timeouts causing partial responses. We should recommend increasing proxy timeouts or switching to chunked transfer.

leo: Added a one-liner about proxy timeouts and an example nginx config snippet in the PR.

docs-bot: Reminder: update the search index and re-run the link checker. Use `scripts/rebuild_search_index.sh` and `make docs-check` before merging.

mira: Will run checks after lunch. If anything else pops up I'll post here.

leo: Thanks  merging after CI green.
